summary: Certara, Inc. filed an 8-K to disclose the closing of the sale of its global medical writing and related regulatory services business to Veristat, LLC. The deal closed on May 8, 2026, for $85 million cash consideration, subject to adjustments, with an additional $15 million placed in escrow and up to $35 million in earn-out contingent on financial performance. No board recommendation or advisors were named. The transaction was previously announced on April 21, 2026, and the registrant updated its 2026 guidance to reflect the divestiture. Watch for earn-out milestones and potential use of proceeds for reinvestment or debt reduction.
